Reason for Mistake: The user incorrectly identified the voice actor of J.A.R.V.I.S. in Iron Man as Robert Downey Jr. In reality, Robert Downey Jr. plays the character of Tony Stark (Iron Man). The voice of J.A.R.V.I.S. is provided by Paul Bettany. Consequently, the subsequent conclusion about the spouse (Susan Downey) is based on false premises.
